Welcome! This GitHub repository contains the materials related to the workshop "QGIS and Map-Making in R." We will discuss spatial data and the basics of spatial visualization here before hopping into QGIS to familiarize ourselves with the tool and begin making maps. 

Begin by clicking the "Get Started" link below.

[Get Started >>>](sections/1-LearningGoals.md)

---

This workshop is offered by the [Navari Family Center for Digital Scholarship](cds.library.nd.edu) in the Hesburgh Libraries at the University of Notre Dame. Workshop materials were created by [Summer Mengarelli](mailto:smengare@nd.edu), Data Services Librarian, in October 2026.
